# Owais Abdullah — Spec-Driven Developer & AI Agent Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Owais Abdullah, a spec-driven developer and AI engineer
> based in Karachi, Pakistan. Specializes in Next.js SaaS products, AI agents
> built with the OpenAI Agents SDK, Digital FTEs (AI employees that handle
> business operations 24/7), and WordPress/CMS development.

Currently Senior Developer (Web & AI) at LionUp Digital and Senior Developer &
Manager at AA Marketing (concurrent roles). 3+ years in the industry, 40+
projects delivered across SaaS, e-commerce, AI tools, and automation.

Core stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Python, OpenAI Agents
SDK, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Sanity CMS, WordPress, Shopify.
